financing.title: From a browser command to observed progress
financing.relationship: Reviewed execution handoffs, including asynchronous submission and later observation. These are authored relationships tied to exact source fingerprints; the linked execution evidence verifies behavior separately.

nodes.label: Send a supported command
nodes.detail: The browser sends the session capability, request identity, command and observed version.

nodes.label: Accept and track the request
nodes.detail: The authenticated route validates the request. Submission tracking returns a pending job and owns the asynchronous ledger effect.

nodes.label: Select the application choice
nodes.detail: The workspace rereads visible contracts and selects Approve or Continue. A changed version prevents stale execution.

nodes.label: Exercise through the Ledger API
nodes.detail: The transport submits the selected choice. Daml controllers and application rules remain authoritative.

nodes.label: Read state before painting progress
nodes.detail: Participant-visible contracts become typed financing state, then the shared illustrated scene. A submitted command alone is not a completion.

composition.title: From a proposal to a consented execution
composition.relationship: Reviewed execution handoffs, including asynchronous submission and later observation. These are authored relationships tied to exact source fingerprints; the linked execution evidence verifies behavior separately.

nodes.label: Send a supported command
nodes.detail: The browser sends the session capability, request identity, command and observed version.

nodes.label: Accept and track the request
nodes.detail: The authenticated route validates the request. Submission tracking returns a pending job and owns the asynchronous ledger effect.

nodes.label: Select the consent or execution choice
nodes.detail: A proposed plan, partner acceptance, or enabled action maps to its actual Daml choice.

nodes.label: Enforce partner consent
nodes.detail: The Daml composer owns proposal acceptance and source creation. Process execution remains delegated to the core.

nodes.label: Show observed obligations
nodes.detail: The snapshot decodes completed and enabled steps. The browser renders that state and offers supported actions.

packages.title: From a compiled application to a reviewed adapter
packages.relationship: Reviewed execution handoffs, including asynchronous submission and later observation. These are authored relationships tied to exact source fingerprints; the linked execution evidence verifies behavior separately.

nodes.label: Receive an application DAR
nodes.detail: The bank session may upload or retrieve a bounded package input. The builder retains the original archive identity.

nodes.label: Inspect the compiled package
nodes.detail: Archive parsing enforces size limits and reads Daml-LF declarations, rather than guessing a template from source text.

nodes.label: Generate the reviewed mapping
nodes.detail: An inspected, supported mapping emits a bounded adapter project. A generated project and a compiled DAR are distinct artifacts.

nodes.label: Review before registration
nodes.detail: The browser exposes the inspected mapping, generation result and registration boundary. Package availability does not grant choice authority.
